items.title: Cerebras Systems (CBRS) Teams Up With CrowdStrike To Push AI Cybersecurity
items.summary: Cerebras Systems (NasdaqGS:CBRS) and CrowdStrike announced a partnership to combine Cerebras AI accelerator hardware with the CrowdStrike Falcon AI cybersecurity platform. The alliance includes CrowdStrike using Cerebras chips for its core security offering, while Cerebras adopts Falcon AI to protect its own infrastructure. The collaboration focuses on real-time, AI-driven enterprise security, targeting growing demand in cybersecurity workloads. Cerebras Systems enters this partnership with...
